Safe fail-closed current-upgrade contract for package-distributed web bindings (limen, forma, folio); qualify Praxis 3.7.1 and Ordo 1.4.1
Move conditor to Ordo 1.4.1
conditor adopt: report not-found when a lifecycle component is not installed in the repository even if its CLI is on the machine (installation markers)
Qualify the echelon-current releases: Praxis 3.7.2 and Visual Engineering 1.0.1, with a planned VE 1.0.0 -> 1.0.1 current-upgrade transition
Move conditor to Praxis 3.7.2 and Ordo 1.4.2
Current upgrade verifies with the tools it installed
items.description: conditor upgrade --current installs the target set's native tools into the workstation bin directory, which it adds to future shells' PATH, then runs the full repository verification resolving bare executable names through the Conditor process's own PATH. A newly installed optional native CLI with a repository lifecycle (strata 0.1.0, echelon-current 1.2.0) was therefore 'not found on PATH' and the upgrade failed after installing it; a tool that happened to be on PATH (ordo, praxis) was verified with that other copy instead of the installed one. The existing current-upgrade test masked this by prepending the scratch home's bin directory to PATH.

items.title: Current upgrade opts a project in to an optional native lifecycle tool
items.description: A project could not adopt an optional native repository-lifecycle component its resolved set selects (strata 0.1.0 in echelon-current 1.2.0): declaring it in conditor.json made --current refuse ('manifest has changed since the environment was established'), and the suggested 'conditor init' runs '<tool> init' with a tool nothing had installed. --current now accepts a manifest whose only change since the lock is newly declared components the target set selects as native repository-lifecycle tools at exactly the selected version: it installs them through the workstation plan, runs their lifecycle init with the installed copy, verifies, and commits authority and lock. Any other manifest change still refuses.

items.title: Scaffold for a new NuGet library package repository: foundations manifest, build-and-test and foundations CI, and the Registry release workflow pattern

AdoptionTests 'Registry-authorized adoption succeeds' discovers real praxis/ordo/percepta on PATH (e.g. after conditor workstation apply puts them in ~/.local/bin) and fails; the fixture should isolate PATH
fsharp-nuget-library scaffold must ignore bin/, obj/, dist/ and packages: build output would otherwise be committed
items.description: Found while bootstrapping kemiller2002/arca: the .gitignore that the lifecycle components install has no .NET build-output entries, so 'git add -A' after a build stages bin/ and obj/. The scaffold adds a bounded '# conditor:build-outputs' region to .gitignore. Managed-region markers now follow the host file's comment syntax.

items.title: fsharp-limen-web scaffold has the same .gitignore gap (engine bin/obj): add the build-outputs region there too
fsharp-nuget-library scaffold: make the test project a real dotnet test project (xUnit) so Dokimos and other TRX consumers get test evidence
items.description: Found on kemiller2002/fides#3. The Dokimos quality gate requires tests.total and tests.failed from the TRX that 'dotnet test --logger trx' writes. The scaffold's dependency-free console test runner is invisible to dotnet test, so the gate reported required-evidence-unavailable (exit 3). Generate an xUnit test project (Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk 17.11.1, xunit 2.9.2, xunit.runner.visualstudio 2.8.2, the versions Chrona and Signal pin), run it with dotnet test in build-and-test and release, fail when zero tests run, and ignore TestResults/.

items.title: Indy preset: materialize every Indy-init doc the requirements reference, pinned at the corrected kickoff-path commit
items.description: 17 docs referenced by the materialized Indy-init requirements (INVESTIGATION-ACCEPTANCE-SCENARIOS, OPEN-QUESTIONS, SEMANTIC-COMPILER, ENGINEERING-PROOF-BUNDLE and 13 more) are not materialized, so a fresh agent hits dead links (readiness G1-4, RQR-006). Indy-init PR #6 fixed the kickoff entry path in KICKOFF-EXECUTION-PACKET (G1-5); move every Indy-init pin to its merge commit 012f397 and add the 17 docs.

items.title: Indy preset follows echelon-current: Praxis 3.7.2, Ordo 1.5.0, Limen 0.7.1, Forma 0.4.1
items.description: The indy-init preset pins the frozen Indy Init 0.1.0 set (Praxis 3.6.0, Ordo 1.4.0, Limen 0.6.2, Forma 0.3.0) while hosts and the Registry echelon-current 1.3.0 channel select Praxis 3.7.2 and Ordo 1.5.0 (readiness G1-3/G1-12, RQR-023). Pin every preset component to its echelon-current selection and bind that with a test.

items.title: fsharp-limen-web scaffold: engine tests, browser suite, build-and-test CI with cached Playwright, foundations, inert Pages deploy, branch protection
items.description: The web scaffold had no test project, no CI beyond praxis-validation, no deploy and no branch protection (readiness G1-2). Its npm project under src/kernel could never pass praxis foundations verify, which reads the root package.json and a Limen manifest, and its foundations.json declared percepta, which the Praxis schema forbids (G1-6). Move the npm project to the root, add xUnit engine tests, a Playwright smoke suite, build-and-test with the signal#24 cached-Chromium pattern, the foundations workflow, a Pages deployment gated on DEPLOY_TARGET, and a branch-protection declaration with a fail-closed parser and the GitHub payload.

items.title: conditor repo create: publish an initialized target as a protected GitHub repository
items.description: Nothing created the GitHub repository on the day or configured it for agent work (readiness G1-1). Add conditor repo create: a pure plan (bootstrap commit, gh repo create, origin, push main, merge-commit-only auto-merge, read-only workflow token, scaffold-declared branch protection, optional Pages) from observed local and remote state, fail-closed preconditions, an injected-runner executor that stops at the first failure, and --dry-run. Tested with fakes and real Git; never executed against GitHub.

items.title: Install Registry nuget-library releases distributed as GitHub release assets (ordo-core.nupkg, Arca) into a consumer's local NuGet feed: digest-proven vendor/nuget, lock, NuGet.config source mapping; init, verify and upgrade --current opt-in and version change
items.description: Found while releasing Arca 0.1.0 (arca DF-ARCA-2026-0006): Conditor did not consume ordo-core.nupkg at all; Praxis vendors it by hand. Conditor now installs such releases generally (docs/nuget-feed-contract.md).

items.title: An established scaffold's seed files belong to the project: stop comparing or recreating them once the lock records the scaffold, so a project that grew past its scaffold can still plan, repair and upgrade --current; roll back governance when the current-upgrade commit step fails
items.description: Found aligning kemiller2002/arca to echelon-current 1.3.0: upgrade --current wrote the new authority and conditor.json, then failed building the lock plan on scaffold drift, leaving them with a stale lock.

items.title: Release Conditor 0.5.0 so consumers get local-feed NuGet installs (#59) and scaffold ownership (#60)
items.description: Conditor main carries GitHub-release-asset NuGet local-feed installs (WI-0021, #59) and scaffold ownership/governance rollback (WI-0022, #60), but v0.4.0 predates both. Request 0.5.0 through release/requested-version.txt so release-orchestrator tags and publishes it; Chrona needs it to add Arca 0.2.0.

items.title: conditor supervise: sustainable headless Claude launch with explicit permission mode, resume on exit and a deadline
items.description: The Claude launcher ran claude -p with no permission mode, the preset defaulted to Codex (not installed), and nothing relaunched an agent that exited (readiness G1-9). Add execution.permissionMode, an explicit --permission-mode on every Claude launch, conditor supervise with a pure decision core (start once, resume fresh sessions, backoff on fast exits, stop on completion, block, drained queue, deadline, stop file or budget), queue and deadline aware instructions, Claude settings in the web scaffold, and switch the Indy preset to Claude in auto mode.

items.title: CI smoke checks follow the web scaffold's root package.json
items.description: PR #57 moved the fsharp-limen-web npm project to the repository root. The push-only empty-repository-smoke job and scripts/rehearse-clean-room.sh (factory-rehearsal-smoke) still test src/kernel/package.json, so ci on main failed at f3e08a3. Point them at the root package.json. (INDY-* ids avoid colliding with the concurrent WI-* sequence.)

items.title: conditor requirements import: pinned planning documents to Praxis slice work items with a full trace
items.description: No command turned the Indy-init requirements into Praxis work (readiness step 2 blocker). Add a declarative requirementsImport section to the manifest (documents with heading patterns and expected counts, added slices, assignment rules), a pure planner (extract, order, assign, items, trace, digest, reconcile), a thin shell over the Praxis CLI and Git, the CLI with --check and --authorize, the Indy mapping (23 slices, 980 source IDs), DF-CON-2026-A001 and docs.

items.title: Indy day-of defaults: demo-readiness never-cut, baseline security and trace view as slice acceptance criteria, Pages deploy, AI, persistence, organizer and demo decisions
items.description: Apply the user-accepted day-of decisions: keep auto permission mode (R0 must prove merges), make demo-readiness never-cut, add baseline security (no secrets in the client, CSP, input validation) to never-cut slices, publish a read-only trace view in the Factory View, deploy to GitHub Pages, and record defaults for RQR-003, RQR-004, RQR-001 and RQR-008 (DF-CON-2026-A002). Adds an acceptance list to requirementsImport; the import digest changes to 668b64b7.

items.title: Release Conditor 0.6.0 so consumers get requirements import, supervise and the Indy day-of defaults
items.description: Conditor main carries the CI smoke fix (#61, INDY-0001), conditor requirements import (#63, INDY-0002), conditor supervise (#64, INDY-0003) and the Indy day-of defaults with per-slice acceptance criteria and a new import digest (#65, INDY-0004), but v0.5.0 predates them (#55-#58 already shipped in 0.5.0). Request 0.6.0 through release/requested-version.txt so release-orchestrator tags and publishes it.

items.title: URL-addressable state by default: fsharp-limen-web scaffolds the route inventory, the routing foundation and a pure route codec placeholder until Limen 0.9.0; SAF-URL-1..10 in the web requirement checklist
items.description: Portfolio deep-linking standard (Praxis SAF-URL-1..10, Limen DF-LIMEN-2026-0006). New web applications get .echelon/routes.json (echelon.routes/v1, hash mode), the routing capability in .echelon/foundations.json, a pure Routes.fs codec with round-trip tests to be replaced by Limen.Routing at 0.9.0, and requirements/URL-ADDRESSABLE-STATE.md.

items.title: Release Conditor 0.7.0: URL-addressable state in the web scaffold (#68)
items.description: Minor release: fsharp-limen-web scaffolds the route inventory, the routing foundation, a pure route codec placeholder for Limen.Routing and the SAF-URL-1..10 checklist (WI-0025, PR #68).

items.title: Scaffold route inventory in Limen 0.9.0's exact echelon.routes/v1 shape, and pin the foundations CI to the Praxis verifier that vendors Limen's schema
items.description: Limen 0.9.0 published contract/routes.schema.json: routes carry guards (array), every parameter carries required/default/values, and a {*rest} wildcard is optional. The fsharp-limen-web inventory still wrote guard: null. Align it byte-compatibly and bump PraxisFoundationsRef to the Praxis commit that vendors the schema (praxis#211).

items.title: Wire Limen.Routing into the fsharp-limen-web scaffold once Conditor qualifies Limen 0.9.0 and limen-fsharp 0.9.0 (CON-293)
items.description: Limen 0.9.0 (echelon-current 1.11.0) ships @echelon-foundry/limen/routing and EchelonFoundry.Limen.Routing. CON-293 requires the scaffold to use it instead of the src/engine/Routes.fs placeholder once Limen 0.9.0 is the selected Limen. Blocked on qualifying Limen 0.9.0 in Compatibility.fs (qualified list ends at 0.7.1) and on scaffolding the limen-fsharp NuGet binding.

items.title: Release Conditor 0.7.1: scaffold route inventory in Limen 0.9.0's exact shape (#70)
